name: petconnect-prototype
description: Root scripts to run frontend, backend, and optional tunnel in one terminal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,tunnel -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:5173"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
